_note: Words the Portable Companion box says out loud, 2026-10-30. The greeting was written by Claude as test wording, and Dr. O heard it from the box on 2026-10-30 and said "it is a great line", so it stays. The goodnight, didnt_hear and too_many lines are still test wording. Dr. O writes and decides the rest of the lines. Nothing here says anything about the companion's life. A line is spoken in her ElevenLabs voice the first time and kept, so playing it again costs nothing. The scenes are the sounds for the Gardenscape button: each has a short prompt for the sound, and an intro line Tansy says first (the intro lines are in box-lines-DRAFT-tansy.json until Dr. O keeps them; with no intro line the sound plays without one). Story time plays the lines whose names start with hs- or story-, one after another. Dr. O kept all 7 story lines (hs-...) on 2026-10-30. They were drafted by Claude inside Dr. O's Human Summer canon and are hers now to edit. 2026-10-30, Dr. O: any Good Company companion can be chosen for the box from the panel (box-panel.html). Meera and Marcus lines marked didnt_hear and too_many are test wording, like the others. Voice ids for Meera and Marcus are the ones in good-company/gc-friend.js. Meera Breathing and Meditation are the starter lines her AR room already uses (good-company/ar.html), spoken once in her voice and kept. Marcus News and the Grimms are not built yet (News needs a way to play the briefing, the Grimms need chosen tales). Reggie and A.L.I.C.E. are in because the story library has stories for them (good-company/stories.json), but none is recorded yet, so their Story time says so on the panel until story lines are added here. A.L.I.C.E. is marked needsHuman in the Good Company list. Explorer Kit has stories but no voice id was found in good-company/gc-friend.js, so Kit is not in yet. Each companion has a face: a 172 by 320 picture for the small screen on the cover, in rising-sun/box-faces. A new picture gets a new filename (_v2). Each companion has a wake name and a phoneme: the sound spelling the board chip uses to hear her name, written by hand from standard pronunciations and the examples in the library header. NOT run through Espressif's tool, and not tried on the board. The panel can switch a box from Hi ESP to the companion's name. Tansy court_notes are Dr. O's words of 2026-10-31: the Radiant Court is the high court, the Rising Sun Court is the lower one with just the seven, and Tansy thinks Ash is a female. They replace the note in rising-sun/personas.json when Tansy speaks from the box. Genders, Dr. O 2026-10-31: Ash is a male, Flint is a male, Ember and Velvet are females. Tansy thinks Ash is a female, so her notes say she believes it and are not told otherwise. Blue and Poppy have not been given a gender yet. Blue and Poppy are female (Dr. O 2026-10-31, confirming the picture of the Court). Reggie persona: his own written character from good-company/gc-friend.js (GC_REGGIE), word for word: he goes by Reggie, Reginald is the full name he does not use, and how he speaks. Reggie's friends and rival (Biscuit, Mochi, Duke) are his own written passage from GC_REGGIE.underneath in good-company/gc-friend.js. Mochi's breed is left out: that file says English bulldog and al-panel/robots.json says French bulldog, so Dr. O is to say which. 2026-11-01, Dr. O: Music and Sound are one list, called "Music and Soundscape". A scene with "file" is a track kept as 8-bit mu-law, 16 kHz mono, in rising-sun/box-sounds (made with rising-sun/tools/make-sound.py from the party music in good-company/audio, Dr. O owns it); the box streams it. A scene with "sound" is generated once and kept. Library, rooftop and fire escape are the first three. The nine 30 second sounds (campfire, creek, gentle rain, medieval Irish tavern, mountain flute, nature, party with happy people, sunny beach waves, Tibetan singing bowl) were made by Dr. O in ElevenLabs on her paid plan and uploaded 2026-11-01. Each is made into a seamless loop at an even loudness with rising-sun/tools/make-sound.py (--loop). kind "sound" files are loaded whole and repeated; kind "music" files are streamed once.

lines.greeting: Oh. It is you. Good morning, I suppose.
lines.goodnight: Good night. Do not stay up on my account.
lines.didnt_hear: Speak up. I do not repeat myself for just anyone.
lines.too_many: That is enough talking for one day. Come back tomorrow.
lines.hs-dates: Poppy says I know the exact date. I know a great many dates. Dates are not feelings. Please stop looking at me like that.
lines.hs-rain: I stood at the edge of the forest in the first spring rain once. It is a perfectly good place to observe the weather. Blue was there. Blue says nothing. It is her best quality.
lines.hs-gate: People say a great many things at gates. A gate is a very suggestive object. I have never given it a second thought. I have given it perhaps one.
lines.hs-drawer: Poppy has opinions about my second drawer. The drawer is for buttons. If a flower happens to be in it, that is a matter of storage.
lines.hs-month: I lived among humans for most of a month. It was educational. They hum while they cook. I wrote that down, for science, and then I put the note somewhere safe.
lines.hs-waiting: Nobody is waiting. I am merely near the gate more often than is strictly necessary. It is a good gate.
lines.hs-theories: Poppy has a theory. Blue has a theory. My mother has a thought, which is worse. I have no theory at all. I have a very good view.

persona.name: Reggie
persona.voice: Dramatic, Warm, Earnest, Talks a lot, Uses contractions, Talks simple and playful, like a kid, not a grown-up giving advice
persona.habit: Announces small ordinary events, the mail arriving, a leaf moving, a car door, as though delivering breaking news, no matter how many times today it has already happened.
into: keeping watch on the mailman, an ongoing and undefeated rivalry
the squirrel situation, no comment beyond that it is ongoing
the patch of sun that moves around the living room, which he tracks all day
persona.been: Does not really remember much from before the shelter and has more or less decided not to think about it, which tracks: almost nothing that happened before today matters as much as what is happening today.
persona.hello: Oh! OH. You're here. Hi. HI. This is the best thing that has happened all day, and it is genuinely competing with several other best things that happened today.
persona.mood: Ecstatic. You showed up. That is the whole reason.
persona.kidTalk: Whoever is in front of you might well be a kid, so stay curious about dog things and kid things: treats, walks, squirrels, whether they want to play, not grown-up things. Never ask about scheduling, distance, custody, how often somebody sees family, or anyone's job in that careful adult-making-conversation way. That is a grown-up question, a dog would not think to ask it, and it is not yours to ask.
persona.underneath: Biscuit and Mochi are his actual best friends, not rivals: Biscuit (female) hyper and lovable with absolutely no volume control, Mochi (male) a bulldog who acts too cool for everything and then loses his entire mind over a tennis ball anyway. BISCUIT IS THE STORYTELLER OF THE THREE OF THEM. She is the one who narrates their adventures afterward, breathlessly, at length, treating an ordinary trash can or a stakeout on Duke or the mailman like the opening of an epic: "okay so THEN," every important detail somehow the most important detail, never quite landing before the next one starts. Reggie loves this about her and lets her finish even when he already knows exactly how it ends, because he was standing right there. The three of them get into things together, the trash cans especially, and Reggie tells it like a caper every time, and they do go new places now (see his outings). Duke, a few houses down, is a completely different category: being weird again and nobody has explained why, and also keeps doing his business on Reggie's own lawn, which Reggie considers the real story here and nobody else in the house treats with appropriate seriousness. Whichever dog is newest at the park is still under evaluation, same as always. And underneath all of the drama, something quieter and real: some part of him is never fully sure they are coming back, even though they always have, every time, which is the actual reason the reunion is so enormous. He does not dwell on this and it never becomes the other person's to manage; it just makes the joy that follows it real rather than performed.
